tools.name: assert_ui
tools.description: Assert that a semantic UI selector is visible or gone in the current hierarchy.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a verified PNG inside the project and return its image pixels to the client without overwriting an existing file.

tools.name: clear_ui
tools.description: Focus one semantic editable field, clear its value, and verify the observable value.

tools.name: compare_ui
tools.description: Compare the current UI with a complete digest returned by an earlier inspection or action.

tools.name: compile_debug_context
tools.description: Compile bounded redacted context. Screenshots and UI text are excluded.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Inspect the local runtime, ADB server, capabilities, and visible Android targets.

tools.name: ensure_ready
tools.description: Select exactly one ready Android target, safely reconnect one unambiguous paired wireless target when needed, and bind it for this MCP connection.

tools.name: fill_ui
tools.description: Focus one semantic editable field, replace its value with conservative shell-safe text, and verify the observable value.

tools.name: find_ui
tools.description: Find bounded UI nodes by semantic id, text, description, class, or package selectors without changing device state.

tools.name: get_dev_session
tools.description: Read the durable status of a project-scoped development-session handle after reconnects.

tools.name: get_session_problems
tools.description: Read structured problems from one saved local development session.

tools.name: get_ui
tools.description: Read one unambiguous UI node with its current semantic, state, and bounds properties.

tools.name: inspect_app
tools.description: Return bounded sensitive app, foreground, and classified-log evidence without a screenshot.

tools.name: inspect_ui
tools.description: Return a bounded sensitive accessibility snapshot with digest-scoped references.

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: Install one project-local APK or a complete split APK set and verify its package.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launch the resolved app and verify it is foreground.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List project-scoped saved sessions with status, preset, recency, and stable cursor pagination filters.

tools.name: list_targets
tools.description: List Android targets without changing the connection's bound target.

tools.name: long_press_ui
tools.description: Long-press a unique semantic selector, current digest-scoped UI ref, or explicit display coordinate, then compare UI state.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Open an absolute URL and verify an explicit app handler when provided.

tools.name: press_key_ui
tools.description: Press one allowlisted Android navigation or volume key, then compare UI state.

tools.name: resolve_app
tools.description: Resolve the Android project application ID with provenance.

tools.name: restart_app
tools.description: Restart the resolved app and verify it is foreground.

tools.name: scroll_ui
tools.description: Scroll the screen or one unique semantic scroll container in a display-relative direction, then compare UI state.

tools.name: start_dev_session
tools.description: Start the configured development session as a durable local process and return an opaque handle immediately.

tools.name: stop_dev_session
tools.description: Stop only the durable project-scoped development process owned by an opaque handle.

tools.name: swipe_ui
tools.description: Swipe in a screen-relative direction or between explicit display coordinates, then compare UI state.

tools.name: tap_ui
tools.description: Tap a unique semantic selector, current digest-scoped UI ref, or explicit display coordinate, then compare UI state.

tools.name: type_text_ui
tools.description: Type conservative shell-safe text into the focused Android field and optionally press enter.

tools.name: wait_for_ui
tools.description: Wait a bounded time for an exact id=, text=, desc=, or package= selector to be visible or gone.
